versions.changelog: Rename to docx-builder, refine description for clarity

Initial release — professional Word (.docx) document generator for Node.js using the docx npm library.

- Supports generating executable Node.js scripts to produce Word documents with professional styling.
- Built-in style system: brand colors, typography, borders, tables, heading hierarchy.
- Provides reusable business components: requirement tables, boundary conditions, acceptance criteria, change logs, and more.
- Adapts structure for various document types: PRD, technical proposal, project report, meeting minutes, etc.
- Scripts are ready to run with basic `npm install docx` and save `.docx` files directly.
